description: Baseline - both providers healthy (0% induced failure)
Primary fails 100% - all traffic must fall back to backup; primary breaker opens and never recovers
Primary fails 55% - breaker oscillates: opens on failure bursts AND recovers (open -> half_open -> closed) when a probe succeeds; cache + backup keep availability at 100%
Primary 80% / backup 50% - both breakers open, static fallback absorbs the storm and fails fast
